description: This PHP source file defines the class FactorAuthFactory, which manages and provides instances of factor authentication methods for users. It includes methods for retrieving a specific factor authentication mechanism based on user settings or defaults, handling external class inclusion, and exceptions related to user identification.

classes.name: FactorAuthFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and managing instances of factor authentication objects based on user settings or defaults.

methods.name: getFactorAuth
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of a FactorAuthInterface based on the provided or current user, handling loading the class file if necessary, and throwing exceptions if user data is invalid or missing.
